english: Let $A(2,1,0)$, $B(-3,5,0)$ and $C(3,-3,c)$, where $c>0$, be the vertices of a triangle such that the area of triangle $ABC$ is $\dfrac{25}{16}$ times the area of the triangle whose vertices are the feet of the perpendiculars drawn from $A$, $B$ and $C$ to the $xy$-plane. Let $\theta$ be the acute angle between the plane of triangle $ABC$ and the $yz$-plane. Then the value of $\cos\theta$ is ______.
hindi: माना कि $A(2,1,0)$, $B(-3,5,0)$ तथा $C(3,-3,c)$, जहाँ $c>0$ है, एक त्रिभुज के शीर्ष हैं जिससे त्रिभुज $ABC$ का क्षेत्रफल उस त्रिभुज के क्षेत्रफल का $\dfrac{25}{16}$ गुना है जिसके शीर्ष $A$, $B$ तथा $C$ से $xy$-तल पर डाले गए लम्बों के पाद हैं। माना कि $\theta$ त्रिभुज $ABC$ के तल तथा $yz$-तल के बीच का न्यून कोण है। तब $\cos\theta$ का मान ______ है।
solution: Normal of plane $ABC$: $(12,15,16)$, magnitude $25$; normal of the $yz$-plane: $\hat{i}$
solution_full: The feet of the perpendiculars from $A$, $B$, $C$ to the $xy$-plane are $A'(2,1,0)$, $B'(-3,5,0)$, $C'(3,-3,0)$; the third coordinate is dropped and the first two are unchanged.
Area of $A'B'C'$ by the coordinate formula $\dfrac12\left|x_1(y_2-y_3)+x_2(y_3-y_1)+x_3(y_1-y_2)\right|$:
Hence the area of triangle $ABC$ is $\dfrac{25}{16}\times 8=\dfrac{25}{2}$.

Then a normal to the plane $ABC$ is $\overrightarrow{n}=(12,15,16)$ with $|\overrightarrow{n}|=\sqrt{144+225+256}=25$. (Check: the $\hat{k}$-component $16$ gives $\cos$ of the angle with the $xy$-plane $=\dfrac{16}{25}$, matching the area ratio.)
The angle between two planes is the angle between their normals; the $yz$-plane has normal $\hat{i}$.
originality_note: New: the third vertex is fixed only through the ratio of the triangle's area to the area of its shadow on the xy-plane (2D coordinate area formula), and the cross-product components then give the inclination to a different coordinate plane (way 5). Closest known: area of a triangle from its vertices by the cross product; projection of an area onto a plane. Different because: the unknown coordinate enters only through the area ratio, and the answer is read from another component of the normal.

concept_use.Application of cross product: AB x AC = (4c, 5c, 16) gives the area (1/2)sqrt(41c^2+256) = 25/2, so c = 3, and its components are the normal used for cos theta = 12/25.
concept_use.Area of triangle: Area of the projected triangle with vertices (2,1), (-3,5), (3,-3) by the coordinate formula equals 8, which fixes the area of ABC as 25/2.

stem_review: Read as a student: every vector, line and point is introduced before use, every condition is stated, each sentence has one reading; the answer was recomputed independently with sympy and numpy, is unique and equals the Answer Plan. Checked that the triangle is non-degenerate for c = 3, that c > 0 removes c = -3, and that 'acute angle between the planes' gives a unique cosine. Changed: No change.
key_step: Turning the area ratio into an equation for c via the 2D area of the projection and |AB x AC|, then reading the yz-plane inclination from the normal.
justification: Two ideas linked: the coordinate area of the projected triangle and the cross-product area in space, then the angle between planes from the normal. Comparable to the plane-and-area statements of 2026-P1-Q6 (L3); more than the single area computation of 2026-P2-Q1 (L2).
